issues.item: Product size options (Design: Product Details / Cart & Checkout vs Database)
issues.message: The design offers Classic/Deluxe/Grand size options with price deltas and shows size in cart lines, but the schema has no product variants table and no size column in cart_items or order_items, so the chosen size and price cannot be stored or reordered.

issues.item: Checkout data not persisted (Design: Cart & Checkout vs Database carts/orders)
issues.message: The design collects a delivery time window, shows Tax and a promo code in the order summary, and takes a gift message before the order exists, but carts has no time-slot or gift_message column and orders has no delivery time window, tax or discount column, so the summary total cannot be reproduced.

issues.item: Design features lacking requirements and data support
issues.message: The design includes saved favorites (heart), product and courier star ratings, and courier 'Message' chat, none of which appear in the requirements or have tables in the database schema.

issues.item: Navigation flow (Design: Orders tab / Order Tracking / Account & Order History)
issues.message: The Orders tab opens a single Order Tracking screen while Order Tracking's back action returns to an 'Orders list' that exists only inside the Profile-tab screen, leaving no clear order list destination for the Orders tab.

required_fixes: Either remove the size selector from the design or add a product variant/size model (e.g., product_variants table with price delta, plus variant reference and size snapshot in cart_items and order_items).

Add the missing checkout fields to the schema (delivery time window on carts and orders, tax_amount and discount/promo fields on orders, gift_message on carts) or remove the time slot, tax, promo code and pre-order gift message from the design.
Reconcile design-only features: add requirements and tables for favorites, ratings and courier messaging, or remove the heart-save, star-rating and Message chat elements from the design.
Define the Orders tab destination as an order list screen (active and past orders) that links to Order Tracking, and make Order Tracking's back action return to it.
recommendations: Define a single source of truth for order status by documenting how orders.status, deliveries.status and order_status_history stay in sync (e.g., a transition map and a transaction that writes all three), and map the design's 'Order placed' step to the 'paid' status.
Add a stock-reservation or row-locking strategy at order placement to prevent overselling under 200 concurrent users, and add a CHECK constraint on stock_quantity >= 0.
Clarify the encryption approach for users.email (a login identifier that cannot be encrypted at the column level without a blind index) and add DB-level CHECK constraints for role and status values.
